== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_127</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 127), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-127-I_Can_t_Believe_He_s_Gone.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-icantbelievehesgone-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If Obi-Wan is out of play, use 1 Force to deploy on table. During battle, may use 1 Force to add 5 to your total power there for remainder of turn. Once per turn, if Luke a captive, may activate 1 Force. (Immune to Control.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L5593</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>11_19</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 127, Virtual Block 1 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
